svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Return to the four ELI16 stories. C1 preserves history; C2 owns beliefs with inherited evidence; pure PLN supplies the existing guarded mathematics; C3 owns priority and causal feedback; C4 bounds work and reports closure separately. M4 adds a narrow shared generated-result commitment through existing ports. Exact approval precedes signing; saved signed bytes survive retry; actual post-state readback and matching deploy-effect finality close the chain claim. Four native kill boundaries, node outage/restart and an independent read-only process exercise recovery. All ten required M4 gates and full M1–M3.1 regression pass. Private cognition remains off-chain. Single-validator local success is a precise integration result, not production readiness or evidence that the reasoning is true.
svg.text: Real Hive → real DeTTa → approved result → real local chain
with independent commits, restart and matching readback.
M4 COMPLETE · ALL 10 REQUIRED GATES PASS
